desc: Boki wading (GARDEN.md section 4, scripts/home/boki_wade.gd; only while farm_build.json base_mode is on). A Boki in pond or stream water walks at wade_speed (shallow edge) or deep_speed (the middle) of its dry speed, leaves a ripple every ripple_secs and a splash going in, and shakes off coming out. Water, Ice and Crystal leans paddle: with linger_chance a free roaming one stays linger_secs in the water playing (the splash clip) and gains joy_per_sec. Fire leans hurry out: at out_speed to the nearest dry ground, which takes under 2 s. Everyone else wades through. Units: multipliers of walk speed, seconds, joy points a second.
paddle_doc: Lean or species-theme keys (HomeToys.lean_of) that paddle: the Water, Ice and Crystal types (themes prism and frost today).
fire_doc: Lean or species-theme keys that step out fast: the Fire type (theme ember today).
out_reach_doc: m: how far a Fire Boki looks for dry ground to step out to.
